I need to bid on the Marvin Gardens auction.

The current bid is $300. I have $1006 and no monopolies yet. I own Atlantic Avenue in the yellow group, so I need to decide whether to raise to $301.

Winning would give me two of three yellows. I still need cash for New York and Virginia. p2 already owns St. Charles and Indiana, so he cannot complete a pink monopoly.

p2 does not own any yellow properties. If he wins Marvin, he could trade it to complete a monopoly for someone else or demand a high price. I should bid $301 to deny him that trade chip.

I am weighing whether to jump to $320 or stay at the minimum $301. p2 has been bidding aggressively and seems committed, so a higher bid might end the auction quickly or waste money if he drops.

I will bid $301. I am not dropping out now.

p3 dropping out removes the immediate threat of a yellow monopoly for them. p2 winning Marvin would not instantly complete a yellow set for p3, since p3 still lacks Atlantic Avenue. To secure a yellow monopoly myself, I must acquire Ventnor from p3.

A two-of-three yellow set gives me a stronger negotiating position for Ventnor later. I will not trade Park Place to p2 even if he offers it. p3 does not own any monopolies yet, so Marvin would not instantly complete one for them.
